title: Behavioral Patterns and Pitfalls of U.S. Investors
institution: Federal Research Division, Library of Congress
commissioning_context: Prepared under an interagency agreement with the SEC
page_mapping: Printed Arabic page n is PDF page n+3. Cover, preface and contents occupy PDF pages 1-3.
source_status: User-supplied literature review, not a regulator rulebook, diagnostic scale or contemporary market assessment.
review_method: Full text of the supplied report, including bibliography, reviewed; printed page 14 also visually checked.
underlying_studies: Cited studies have not been independently re-reviewed or updated in this adaptation.
author_disclaimer: The report states that its findings do not necessarily represent the SEC, its commissioners or staff.
excluded_inferences: No demographic predictions about individual clients.
No rule that 300 stocks are necessary.
No promise that value always beats growth or that momentum always fails.
No current annuity, tax, retirement or regulatory recommendations.
No claim that a trade result identifies the client's hidden motive.
project_extensions: Illustrative dialogue examples and evaluation criteria
scope: English runtime content, with instructions to respond in the investor's preferred language.
